name: Virtual Select
summary: A long list of choices that the browser only lays out near the viewport. The rows far away are skipped, and the browser is told how tall such a row is, so the scrollbar is right without every row being built.
summaryZh: 一长串选项,浏览器只把靠近视口的那几行真的排出来。远处的行被跳过,浏览器同时被告知这种行有多高,所以滚动条是对的,却不用把每一行都建出来。

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: The list has a frame and sits on the overlay surface. The base class on its own is this, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The list drops its frame and its fill, so it sits straight on the page.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The rows take the small control height, and the placeholder size follows it, so the scrollbar is right at this size too.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default list. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The rows take the large control height, and the placeholder size follows it.

states.name: Checked
states.note: The chosen row takes the brand's barely-there tint, and the words on it take the foreground the contract writes for that tint.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes inside the row, the way the ring on a button in a row goes inside it: an outside ring would be cut off by the scroller.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The choice is out of reach. It is the real disabled attribute on the radio, so the row leaves the tab order.

states.name: Scrollbar always on
states.note: The scrolling box keeps its scrollbar whether the list needs one or not, so the rows do not move sideways as the list grows.

states.name: Empty
states.note: The list holds no option at all. The list says so and leaves the reason to the page that owns the data.

states.name: Clearable
states.note: The field carries the mark that clears the choice.

states.name: Collapse tags
states.note: Only the first chip is shown, so the field keeps one line. How many were folded is the host's to say.

states.name: Filterable
states.note: The field carries the input the host filters the list with.

states.name: Fit input width
states.note: The list takes the width of the component it stands in rather than the width its own words ask for.

states.name: Dark effect
states.note: The component's own surface is filled with the brand colour.

states.name: Plain effect
states.note: The component's own surface drops the frame and the fill.

states.name: Loading
states.note: The data is on its way, so the list says so instead of showing rows that are not there yet.

states.name: Tag in success
states.note: The chips take the success colour.

states.name: Tag in warning
states.note: The chips take the warning colour.

states.name: Tag in danger
states.note: The chips take the danger colour.

states.name: Tag in info
states.note: The chips take the neutral information colour.

states.name: Tag effect dark
states.note: The chips are a solid fill in the colour their type names.

states.name: Tag effect plain
states.note: The chips are an outline in the colour their type names, with no fill.

parts.name: Scroller
parts.note: The bounded box the list scrolls in. How much of a long list fits on a page is the host's business, so its height is the host's.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: What stands above the options: a filter, a note. It takes no room when the host has nothing to put in it.

parts.name: List
parts.note: The listbox. It holds the rows.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: One row. It is the row the browser skips when it is far away, so it carries the row's own size with it.

parts.name: Label
parts.note: The label around the radio. Clicking the row picks its option. It clips what it holds: a row the browser has not laid out yet is only as wide as the placeholder it stands in for, and the words must not run past the box that holds them.

parts.name: Text
parts.note: The words of the option. A long name is cut with an ellipsis rather than wrapped, so every row keeps one height — which is what the placeholder size of a row the browser has not laid out yet has to match.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: What stands below the options: a note, a load-more row. It takes no room when the host has nothing to put in it.

parts.name: Field
parts.note: The row above the list: it holds the prefix, the chips that show the choice, the filter and the clear mark. It takes no room when the host has asked for none of them.

parts.name: Prefix
parts.note: The mark that stands in front of the control. It is the host's own, so the library draws no glyph of its own.

parts.name: Tags
parts.note: The row of chips that shows the choice.

parts.name: Tag
parts.note: One chip. It holds one chosen value, and the type and the effect say how it is painted.

parts.name: Filter
parts.note: The input the host filters the list with. It is a real search field, so the filtering is the host's script.

parts.name: Clear
parts.note: The mark that clears the choice. It is drawn from two bars, so it carries no text of its own, and it is a real button so the keyboard can reach it.

parts.name: Loading
parts.note: What the list says while the data is on its way.

props.name: value
props.description: The label of the option that is chosen. It is the radio's own value, so the choice is the browser's and not the library's.
props.descriptionZh: 被选中的那个选项,写成它的名字。它是单选按钮自己的值,所以这个选择是浏览器做的,不是库做的。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The bound value. It answers to `v-model` as well as to `value`, and the binding wins when it is there.
props.descriptionZh: 绑定的值。它和 `value` 一样能接 `v-model`,而且绑定在的时候以绑定为准。

props.name: options
props.description: The labels in the list, separated by commas. The wrapper draws one option per label; the markup writes the options out.
props.descriptionZh: 列表里的那些名字,用逗号分开。包装组件按每个名字画一个选项;标记里是把选项一个个写下来的。

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text that names the list and stands in for a choice. It is the accessible name of the listbox, so the browser announces it when the reader reaches the list. The library has no field to write a selection into, so the placeholder is what the list is called.
props.descriptionZh: 给这个列表起名字、也代替一次选择的那段文字。它是列表框的可访问名称,所以读屏走到这个列表时会播报它。库里没有可以写进选择值的字段,所以由这个占位文字来给列表命名。

props.name: height
props.description: The height of the scroller. It is a length and not a number of pixels: how tall the window onto the list is belongs to the host's page.
props.descriptionZh: 滚动区的高度。它是一个长度,不是多少像素:这个列表开多大一个窗口,是宿主页面的事。

props.name: size
props.description: How tall a row is and how big the type in it is. The middle size needs no modifier class.
props.descriptionZh: 一行有多高,里面的字有多大。中间那一档不用加修饰类。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the choice out of reach. It is the real disabled attribute on every radio, so the rows leave the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让选择不可用。它是每个单选按钮上的原生 disabled 属性,因此这些行会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: scrollbar-always-on
props.description: Whether the scrolling box keeps its scrollbar whether the list needs one or not, so the rows do not move sideways as the list grows. It adds um-virtual-select--scrollbar-always-on.
props.descriptionZh: 滚动区是否一直留着滚动条,不管这份清单用不用得上,这样清单变长时行不会横向挪动。它加上 um-virtual-select--scrollbar-always-on。

props.name: clearable
props.description: Whether the field carries the mark that clears the choice. It adds um-virtual-select--clearable.
props.descriptionZh: 输入区上是否带那个清空选择的记号。它加上 um-virtual-select--clearable。

props.name: collapse-tags
props.description: Whether only the first chip is shown, so the field keeps one line. How many were folded is the host's to say. It adds um-virtual-select--collapse-tags.
props.descriptionZh: 是不是只显示第一个标签,于是输入区只占一行。折叠了几个是宿主自己的事。它加上 um-virtual-select--collapse-tags。

props.name: filterable
props.description: Whether the field carries the input the host filters the list with. The input is a real search field, so the filtering is the host's script and the library only draws it. It adds um-virtual-select--filterable.
props.descriptionZh: 输入区上是否带上那个供宿主筛选清单的输入框。这个输入框是真的搜索框,所以筛选是宿主脚本的事,库只负责画它。它加上 um-virtual-select--filterable。

props.name: fit-input-width
props.description: Whether the list takes the width of the component it stands in rather than the width its own words ask for. It adds um-virtual-select--fit-input-width.
props.descriptionZh: 清单是否取所在容器的宽度,而不是由自己的文字撑出来的宽度。它加上 um-virtual-select--fit-input-width。

props.name: effect
props.description: How the component's own surface is painted. The light effect is the surface the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the dark effect adds um-virtual-select--effect-dark and the plain effect adds um-virtual-select--effect-plain.
props.descriptionZh: 组件自己的底面怎么画。浅色效果就是库画的这个底面,不需要修饰类;深色效果加上 um-virtual-select--effect-dark,朴素效果加上 um-virtual-select--effect-plain。

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the data is on its way, so the list says so instead of showing rows that are not there yet. It adds um-virtual-select--loading.
props.descriptionZh: 数据是不是还在路上,于是清单说明这件事,而不是显示还没到的行。它加上 um-virtual-select--loading。

props.name: tag-type
props.description: Which colour the chips take. The primary colour is the one the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the other four add um-virtual-select--tag-success, um-virtual-select--tag-warning, um-virtual-select--tag-danger and um-virtual-select--tag-info.
props.descriptionZh: 标签取什么颜色。主色是库画的那个,不需要修饰类;另外四个分别加上 um-virtual-select--tag-success、um-virtual-select--tag-warning、um-virtual-select--tag-danger 和 um-virtual-select--tag-info。

props.name: tag-effect
props.description: How the chips are painted: a tint, a solid fill or an outline with no fill. The tint is the one the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the solid fill adds um-virtual-select--tag-effect-dark and the outline adds um-virtual-select--tag-effect-plain.
props.descriptionZh: 标签怎么画:淡底、实底,还是没有底色的描边。淡底是库画的那个,不需要修饰类;实底加上 um-virtual-select--tag-effect-dark,描边加上 um-virtual-select--tag-effect-plain。

slots.name: label
slots.description: What one option says. It is given the label of the option and the option's number.
slots.descriptionZh: 某一个选项写什么。它拿到这个选项的名字和它的序号。

slots.name: default
slots.description: What one option holds. It is the name Element Plus gives the same content the label slot fills.
slots.descriptionZh: 某一个选项装着什么。它是 Element Plus 给 label 插槽所填的同一份内容起的名字。

slots.name: empty
slots.description: What the list says when it holds no option at all.
slots.descriptionZh: 这个列表一个选项都没有的时候说什么。

slots.name: header
slots.description: What stands above the options: a filter, a note.
slots.descriptionZh: 选项上面放什么:一个筛选,或者一句说明。

slots.name: footer
slots.description: What stands below the options: a note, a load-more row.
slots.descriptionZh: 选项下面放什么:一句说明,或者一行加载更多。

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: The mark that stands in front of the control. It is the host's own, so the library draws no glyph of its own.
slots.descriptionZh: 控件前面的记号。它是宿主自己的,所以库不画任何字形。

slots.name: tag
slots.description: What one chip says. It is given the label of the chip and its number. Without it the chip is empty, and an empty chip is not drawn.
slots.descriptionZh: 某一个标签写什么。它拿到这个标签的名字和它的序号。不给就空着,而空着的标签不画出来。

slots.name: loading
slots.description: What the list says while the data is on its way.
slots.descriptionZh: 数据还在路上的时候,清单说什么。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when an option is picked. It is the browser's own event on the radio — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 选中一个选项时触发。这是单选按钮上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: clear
events.description: Fires when the clear mark is pressed. The value that follows is the empty one, and the update:modelValue event carries it.
events.descriptionZh: 按下清空记号时触发。接下来的值是空值,update:modelValue 事件会带着它。

a11y.notes: The list is a radio group, because every row is a real radio: the browser says what the group holds, the arrow keys move between the choices, and the browser announces the picked one. The radio is kept out of sight with the same technique the switch uses, so it is still a control the keyboard can reach. Each radio names itself, because a row is a label and a label carries no text of its own. The rows carry no option role, because a role is a promise: an option is a stop in the tab order, and the stop here is the radio inside the row rather than the row around it.
a11y.notesZh: 列表是单选组,因为每一行都是真的单选按钮:浏览器会说明这个组装的是什么,方向键可以在选项之间走,浏览器也会播报选中的那一个。那个单选按钮是用开关组件的同一套办法藏起来的,所以它仍然是一个键盘够得到的控件。每个单选按钮都自带名字,因为一行是一个标签,标签自己不带文字。行本身不写 option 角色 —— 角色是一个承诺:option 是 Tab 顺序里的一个停靠点,而这里的停靠点是行里那个单选按钮,不是包着它的这一行。

examples.title: A long list
examples.description: Seventy rows in a box twelve em tall. The browser lays out the rows near the viewport and skips the rest, and the placeholder size tells it how tall a skipped row is, so the scrollbar is the right length even though most of the list has never been painted.
examples.descriptionZh: 七十行,放在一个十二 em 高的盒子里。浏览器只排视口附近的那些行,其余的跳过;那个占位尺寸告诉浏览器跳过的行有多高,所以哪怕大部分列表从来没有被画出来,滚动条的长度也是对的。

examples.title: Plain
examples.description: The same list without the frame and without the fill, so it sits straight on the page. Only the modifier class changes.
examples.descriptionZh: 同一份列表,去掉外框,也去掉底色,直接坐在页面上。变的只有那个修饰类。

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: The same list small and large. The rows take the size, and the placeholder size follows them, so the scrollbar is right at every size.
examples.descriptionZh: 同一份列表,小一号和大一号。行跟着尺寸走,占位尺寸也跟着走,所以每一种尺寸下滚动条都是对的。

notes: The rows far from the viewport are not laid out: `content-visibility: auto` tells the browser to skip the work for them, and `contain-intrinsic-size` says how big a row that has never been looked at is. The row height is a length of the component's own and not a number of pixels, because a row's height follows the theme's type and the library's pixel allowlist has no row in it. The options are real radios inside labels, so the selection is a form value the host can read; the virtualisation is only about the painting, and nothing about the choice changes because of it.
notesZh: 离视口远的那些行不会被排出来:`content-visibility: auto` 让浏览器跳过对它们的活儿,`contain-intrinsic-size` 告诉浏览器一个还没被看过的行有多高。行高是组件自己的一个长度,不是多少像素,因为行高要跟着主题的字号走,而库的像素白名单里没有行高这一项。选项是包在 label 里的真单选按钮,所以选中的值是宿主读得到的表单值;虚拟化只跟画出来的东西有关,选择本身一点也没有因此改变。
